WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow, AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount
  FROM orderexecutions AS oe
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark
  WHERE CAST(oe.expirespot AS TEXT) > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496'
    AND CAST(oe.expirespot AS TEXT) < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533'
  GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow
)
SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount)
FROM group_averages;
